@@note: Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR, você), made for the device's UI from the mobile app's (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_pt.arb, master bdb174e) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, locales/pt.yml, main b89ad0a) translations where they had the text or the term (both GPL-3.0, the same author's; their words, register and typography are kept; the terminal's MP3-player tab is European Portuguese, so its words were reworded to Brazilian: fones de ouvido, tela, arquivo, parear, reiniciando), and translated by a Fable agent (Claude) otherwise, then reviewed message by message by a second Fable agent (a Brazilian Portuguese review: wording, agreement, terms, widths). A machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native speaker: a review as a pull request on this file is welcome. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, with the Auto DJ engine's UI) were made the same way: the mobile app's Auto DJ words (Auto DJ, Âncora, Seguir o clima, Manter a semente, Limite de semelhança, Continuidade de BPM, Mixagem harmônica, 'a partir daqui') and a Fable agent's translation for the rest, fitted with the same checker; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
